# Check remaining bars - focus on right panel only
seg = current_frame.segmentation
light_gray = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w']

# Separate left and right panel bars
left_bars = []

for n in light_gray:
    b = n['boundary']
    col = b[0][1]
    center_row = (b[0][0] + b[-1][0]) // 2
    if col >= 35:  # right panel
        right_bars.append((center_row, col))
    else:
        left_bars.append((center_row, col))

print(f"Left panel bars: {len(left_bars)} - {left_bars}")
print(f"Right panel bars: {len(right_bars)} - {right_bars}")

# Click only right panel bars
actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c in sorted(right_bars)]
action(actions, intent='solve')
